title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary: Bitcoin holds 75,787 after a one-percent slide as fear hits 25 on the extreme index. Hashrate stays firm at 940 exahashes while 32,000 transactions sit in the mempool with fees at one sat per vbyte. Asia flows remain light into the session. Watch for any bounce if macro data softens later or further downside if selling pressure builds through the London open.
